module: Split screen (multiseat): creates a render view per player (RenderViewManagerInstance, views named 'splitscreen0', 'splitscreen1'...), computes the on-screen layout with render_splitScreenLayouts according to the number of players and the multiseatLayout<N> setting, manages per-player camera contexts, player labels and the 'multiseat' Vue HUD. The extension activates as soon as it is loaded (onExtensionLoaded calls enable) and deactivates on unload. A modder or a mission can force the player list with setCustomPlayers.
usage:
extensions.load('render_splitScreen')
render_splitScreen.setCustomPlayers({0, 1})  -- two views, players 0 and 1
-- ...
render_splitScreen.clearCustomPlayers()
extensions.unload('render_splitScreen')
notes: Depends on core_playerPersonas, render_playerTags and render_playerCompassMarkers (loaded first).
Maximum 64 views (one per player). Empty player list: returns {0}.

To save rendering cost, each view receives a quality factor (meshDetailAdjust and groundCoverScale multiplied): 1.0 for 1 view, 0.75 for 2, 0.6 for 3, 0.5 for 4 and beyond. Vehicle mirrors and dynamic reflections are turned off except for the solo view. The user's graphics settings are not modified.
When enabling the extension: the actions 'vehicleMenues' and 'nodegrabber' are blocked, the 'multiseat' setting is set to true and the 'multiseat' game route is installed.
'shared' mode (shared layout): a single main view is rendered; 'split' mode: one view per player.
The 'performance preset' function (setPerformancePreset) exists but its call is commented out: unused.

Emitted hooks: onSplitScreenChanged(enabled, playerCount, layoutId, mode) on activation and when players or layout change (false alone on deactivation), and onSplitScreenLayoutChanged() on every new layout computation. UI event: MultiseatHudData(count, layout, players, mode) or MultiseatHudData(0).

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded first: core_playerPersonas, render_playerTags, render_playerCompassMarkers.

getPlayers.desc: Returns the ordered list of player indices that have a view: the custom list from setCustomPlayers if it exists, otherwise core_multiseat.getPlayers. Limited to 64; contains {0} if empty.

result.desc: Table to fill and return (reusable to avoid an allocation); created if nil.

returns.desc: false if split screen is inactive.

isSharedView.desc: True if split screen is active, rendered in shared view and without a solo view.

setCustomPlayers.desc: Forces the list of players that must have a view (e.g. for a mission), or removes it with nil. An empty list is equivalent to nil. If split screen is active, recomputes right away.

players.desc: Ordered player indices, or nil to clear the override.

toggleFreeCam.desc: Switches this player's own view to the next camera group (core_camera.cycleCameraGroup).

returns.desc: false if the player has no split screen view (the caller can then use the main camera toggle).

refreshLayout.desc: Forces the layout to be recomputed on the next pass (resets the remembered size) and does it right away if active.

beginSoloView.desc: Temporarily shows a single player in full screen without changing the participant list or the HUD state. With options.mainView = true, uses the main view; otherwise enlarges the player's view with an 'orbit' camera. Player labels are removed during the solo view.

returns.desc: false if player is not numeric or is not in the configured player list (or has no view); true otherwise.

endSoloView.desc: Ends the solo view and restores the context camera and the layout.

returns.desc: true if a solo view was active.

onAfterRouteChange.desc: UI route change hook: sends the HUD state back on each entry into the 'multiseat' route, since the Vue view is remounted with its route.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-mission hook: ends the solo view (endSoloView).

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after a GE Lua reload: restores the saved player list and re-enables split screen.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Extension load hook: restores customPlayers if data is provided and enables split screen.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Unload hook: alias of disable(preserveRoute). Destroys the views, renders the world on the main view, resets exposure to zero and restores the 'play' game route unless preserveRoute.

preserveRoute.desc: If true, does not change the game route.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before a GE Lua reload: returns {customPlayers} and disables split screen while keeping the route, to destroy the C++ views.

reason.desc: Reason for serialization (used in the log).

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when settings change: rebuilds the view quality overrides, which are a snapshot of the global settings.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: recomputes the configuration (players, window size, layout) and updates the players' compass markers.
